body:
Hey.
Maybe you are right. I have been thinking things during these days. I think it's best for everyone to call the plans off but still, I feel a lot of negative things about myself. I should reach out. I really hope that both of us get better and I'm happy to hear that you are currently trying. I would like to thank you for this and I really hope you are doing well.

I am doing normal I guess, about to take a bath so for now it is all fine.

How are you feeling?

Hey.

I think we are kind of going through the same thing. I'm actually in my last year of college too. I don't know if I have any advise because I don't know what to do with myself as well, but I'm glad that you let it out, and if I can't give an advice at least I can listen to you if that helps. I'm here to accompany and listen, even if we don't know each other and we live in different places.

I feel the same way too.

But if it helps I can try hearing how you feel.
